# Dr Abderrahim Zermane

Official website: https://azermane.com/

Dr Abderrahim Zermane is a fire and process safety researcher specialising in physics-based urban fire modelling, occupational accident prevention, fault tree analysis, explainable machine learning, construction safety and evidence-led decision systems.

## Author identity

- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=9ZkzMtcAAAAJ&hl=en
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5040-7704
- GitHub: https://github.com/AbderrahimZ1
